schema Federated Learning Architecture
groups Key Actors

Hospitals A, B, C: Healthcare providers with sensitive patient data. NStarX Central Server: Orchestration hub that coordinates learning without accessing raw data. Data Scientists: Monitor model performance via dashboard.

database Data Flow

Patient data stays local at each hospital. Only encrypted model updates (gradients) flow to the central server. The global model improvements flow back to hospitals, creating a continuous learning loop without exposing any patient information.

psychology AI/ML Model

Federated Learning with differential privacy ensures patient data never leaves hospital premises. Local models train on-site, and only mathematical updates are aggregated centrally to improve the global model.

description How It Works

Each hospital trains AI models locally on their patient data. Instead of sharing raw data, they share only model improvements. The central server combines these improvements to create a better global model, which is then distributed back to all hospitals - enabling collaborative AI without compromising privacy.
